title: Supreme Court Expands Trump's Power to Fire Independent Agency Heads
detail: The Supreme Court ruled to expand President Trump's authority to dismiss heads of independent federal agencies, a decision liberal justices called 'destabilizing.' The ruling excludes Federal Reserve leadership — Trump cannot fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook or the Fed chair — preserving central bank independence.

title: Supreme Court Upholds Counting of Late-Arriving Mail-In Ballots
detail: The Supreme Court upheld a state law allowing mail-in ballots received after Election Day to be counted, rejecting a Republican legal challenge. The ruling has significant implications for future federal and state elections.

media.caption: Supreme Court upholds state law allowing late mail-in ballots to be counted
